games.name: Lost Currents [Alpha]
games.desc:
Lost Currents 

Sail a boat with your friends and dive into the deep depths of the AZR sea. You venture down in an old diving helmet, searching for gold bars while the others watch the boat. But beware, predators lurk below, and the ocean holds dark secrets.
Work together to survive, uncover mysteries, and see how far your courage will take you.

Trial and error will be your guide.

Update v0.10.3
-Many bug fixes (too many to list here
Use code "BUGFIX" for some gold

Update v0.10.2
New UI for the lobby
Expanded map with new islands
New boat: Sailboat (uses the sail as alternative mechanic for movement)
New craftable item: Defibrillator (revive teammates)
Upon death, players now respawn on a lifesaver where they can be revived
Giftbringer receives exclusive Christmas items 
Boat movement stabilized for smoother sailing
New consumable: Coconut (found on islands)
New barrel animation
New effects while driving the boat
Fixed: Workbench now gives items even if inventory is full

games.name: [MALICOPE] Something Boss Fights
games.desc:
"Two immortal beings going through a messy sibling argument until some random guy third-wheeled too hard and now everyone’s dead.” 

Something Boss Fight is a not only a journey but also a life lesson to some. Welcome to an aspiring world where you are met not only with devastating loss but also tremendous ragebaits that probably wasnt even intended.

<< DISCLAIMER: This game is difficult with little to no hand-holding, Practice is an essential aspect, so don't expect to win your way towards the end immediately. >>

Q - Roll (Iframe)
R - Charm activation

You can adjust your settings in the settings menu.
